meta.name: ai-content-quality-auditor
meta.description: 文案诊断助手适合内容创作者、市场营销、运营、内容媒体在用户提出“这段文案能打动人吗”这类问题，需要快速拆解目标、判断重点并形成可执行结果时使用，帮助基于输入材料生成内容诊断、结构化优化建议、可执行发布清单。

copy.tagline: 诊断文案质量并生成优化建议与发布清单
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要快速评估文案效果并得到可执行的改进方案。
copy.tagline_en: Diagnose copy quality and generate actionable optimization suggestions.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to quickly evaluate copy effectiveness and get actionable improvements.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会变成文案诊断助手。当你提供文案或内容目标时，它会分析文案是否打动人，并给出结构化优化建议和可执行的发布清单。
howto.when: 当你提出“这段文案能打动人吗”这类问题，或需要内容诊断、优化建议时触发。适合内容创作者、市场营销、运营等场景。

say.text: 帮我诊断这段文案，看看哪里可以优化。
say.note: Claude 会分析文案并给出建议。

say.text: 我有一篇产品介绍，目标受众是年轻白领，请给出优化建议。
say.note: Claude 会结合受众给出结构化建议。

say.text: 请为这篇文案生成一个发布清单。
say.note: Claude 会输出可执行的发布步骤。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude becomes a copy quality auditor. When you provide copy or content goals, it analyzes whether the copy is compelling and gives structured optimization suggestions and an actionable release checklist.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask questions like 'Is this copy compelling?' or need content diagnosis and optimization suggestions. Suitable for content creators, marketers, and operations.

say_en.text: Diagnose this copy and tell me where to improve.
say_en.note: Claude will analyze and give suggestions.

say_en.text: I have a product intro targeting young professionals, please give optimization advice.
say_en.note: Claude will provide structured suggestions based on audience.

say_en.text: Generate a release checklist for this copy.
